selectOptions.label: Label displayed to user
selectOptions.selected: If enabled, the option is selected by default
selectOptions.valueShared: Values, order and default selections are shared by all languages and edited in the site's default language ({{lang}}); only the label translates. On save, this language is re-aligned on {{lang}}: options added, removed or reordered here are not kept
selectOptions.contributeInMain: Options are authored in the site's default language ({{lang}}). This option carries no value there, so its label is edited there too; options with a value appear here for translation as soon as the field is saved in {{lang}}

minBoundMode.today: Current date (the day the form is submitted)
minBoundMode.relative: Relative date (the current date shifted by a fixed offset)

maxBoundMode.today: Current date (the day the form is submitted)
maxBoundMode.relative: Relative date (the current date shifted by a fixed offset)

minBoundMode.date: Fixed date and time (picked from the calendar)
minBoundMode.today: Current date (from the start of the submission day)
minBoundMode.relative: Relative date (shifted from the current date, from the start of that day)

maxBoundMode.date: Fixed date and time (picked from the calendar)
maxBoundMode.today: Current date (until the end of the submission day)
maxBoundMode.relative: Relative date (shifted from the current date, until the end of that day)

conditionalLogic.valueToday: Current date (the day the form is submitted)
conditionalLogic.betweenInverted: The end date is before the start date: this rule can never match.
conditionalLogic.betweenNoMatch: This rule currently matches no date, so it is ignored when the form is submitted.
conditionalLogic.noSources: No supported source field is available before this field.
conditionalLogic.help: Use fields placed before this one to show or hide it. Eligible fields are those declaring a value kind: choice (select, radio, checkbox), date, number and boolean — including fields contributed by other modules. "No supported source field..." means no compatible previous field was found. A condition can also read something outside the form: a datalayer value, a URL parameter or a cookie. Those are read in the browser only, so a required field shown by such a condition is not enforced when the form is submitted.
conditionalLogic.allSourcesUsed: All available source fields are already used by rules above.
conditionalLogic.unresolvedContext: Unable to resolve the edited field path.
conditionalLogic.formNotFound: Unable to resolve the parent form.
conditionalLogic.loadError: Unable to load available source fields.
conditionalLogic.providerRefMissing: Required: a rule without a name cannot be evaluated and will be removed when saving.
conditionalLogic.providerRefInvalid: This name is not in the expected format and cannot be read on the page.
conditionalLogic.unknownSourceType: This condition uses a source ("{{type}}") that this module version does not provide — it was probably created with a newer version. The rule is kept unchanged and its field stays hidden.
